description: LC-EST-IMAGE-PRECONDITIONS: every registry, secret and OpenBao input that .github/workflows/estate-image.yml (with ci.yml's estate-image-* pull-request jobs) and the aks-obs-01 overlay's ExternalSecrets read, each with the board item that provisions it. Names and presence only; no value is recorded. Checked by test/estate/image-preconditions.test.ts.

preconditions.name: ESTATE_REGISTRY
preconditions.purpose: estate registry host aks-obs-01 pulls from; the publish pushes loopcloser:sha-<commit> there

preconditions.name: OPENBAO_ADDR
preconditions.purpose: estate OpenBao address the registry push login reads its credential from

preconditions.name: kv/loop-closer/registry-push
preconditions.purpose: loop-closer's registry push credential, read through GitHub OIDC and OpenBao JWT auth (roles loop-closer-registry-push, loop-closer-registry-push-check)

preconditions.name: kv/loopcloser/registry-pull
preconditions.purpose: loop-closer's pull-only registry credential, synced into the loopcloser-registry-pull dockerconfigjson Secret

preconditions.name: kv/loopcloser/api
preconditions.purpose: per-agent API keys self-issued by loopcloser (one property per principal), extracted whole into the loopcloser-api-keys Secret mounted at API_KEYS_DIR
